from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Semantic_Execute(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_semantic_execute"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("intent",            "string", widget_type="text",     default="")
        self.add_input("context_json",      "string", widget_type="text",     default="{}")
        self.add_input("dry_run",           "bool",   widget_type="checkbox", default=False)
        self.add_input("auto_commit",       "bool",   widget_type="checkbox", default=True)
        self.add_input("rollback_on_error", "bool",   widget_type="checkbox", default=True)
        self.add_output("success",             "bool")
        self.add_output("operations_executed", "list")
        self.add_output("transaction_id",      "string")
        self.add_output("status",              "string")
        self.add_output("graph_diff",          "any")
        self.add_output("errors",              "list")
        self.add_output("warnings",            "list")
        self.add_output("resource_estimate",   "any")
        self.add_output("report_json",         "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        from src.runtime.semantic_execution import get_semantic_executor
        intent   = str(inputs.get("intent", "")).strip()
        ctx_raw  = inputs.get("context_json") or "{}"
        dry_run  = bool(inputs.get("dry_run", False))
        auto_cmt = bool(inputs.get("auto_commit", True))
        rb_err   = bool(inputs.get("rollback_on_error", True))

        _empty = {
            "exec_out": True, "success": False, "operations_executed": [],
            "transaction_id": "", "status": "failed", "graph_diff": {},
            "errors": [], "warnings": [], "resource_estimate": {}, "report_json": "{}"
        }

        if not intent:
            _empty["errors"] = ["intent must not be empty"]
            return _empty

        try:
            context = json.loads(ctx_raw) if isinstance(ctx_raw, str) else dict(ctx_raw or {})
        except Exception as exc:
            _empty["errors"] = [f"context_json parse error: {exc}"]
            return _empty

        try:
            executor = get_semantic_executor()
            result   = await executor.execute(
                intent, context,
                dry_run=dry_run,
                auto_commit=auto_cmt,
                rollback_on_error=rb_err,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            _empty["errors"] = [f"semantic execution failed: {exc}"]
            return _empty

        return {
            "exec_out":            True,
            "success":             bool(result.get("ok", False)),
            "operations_executed": result.get("operations_executed", []),
            "transaction_id":      result.get("transaction_id") or "",
            "status":              result.get("status", "failed"),
            "graph_diff":          result.get("graph_diff", {}),
            "errors":              result.get("errors", []),
            "warnings":            result.get("warnings", []),
            "resource_estimate":   result.get("resource_estimate", {}),
            "report_json":         result.get("report_json", "{}"),
        }

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Semantic_Execute
